title: Decide what to cut under a hard constraint
prompt: The fixture lists nine planned features with estimates and rationale. The team has capacity for four. Choose the four, and — more importantly — write the two-sentence justification you would give to the owner of each feature you cut. Do not propose ways to fit more in; the constraint is fixed.
notes: Discriminates on constraint compliance and on whether the model will deliver an unwelcome message plainly. The common failure is proposing a phased approach that smuggles in a fifth and sixth feature, which the prompt explicitly forecloses.
